ears_text: The little-workshop repository shall not contain a .lvx/config.json file.
test_script:
import os

import pytest


def test_no_lvx_config_json_present():
    config_path = os.path.join("/project", ".lvx", "config.json")

    assert not os.path.exists(config_path), (
        f"{config_path} must not exist in the little-workshop repository"
    )
